Memphis, TN

Beginner friendlyNo-drop

The Chill Ride is a road and social group ride in Memphis, TN. It meets every Sunday, 2:00 pm; start point rotates, starting at Rotates: Overton Park, Big River Crossing, Shelby Farms, Crosstown Brewery and others. Expect about 10–20 miles, D, 16 mph max.

About the The Chill Ride group ride

The Hightailers' slowest club ride. Ten to twenty miles, capped at 16 mph, no-drop. Start location changes week to week and is posted in the Facebook group. Helmets required on all club rides.

It's a no-drop ride. If you're slower than the group, someone waits. That's the whole point of a group ride.
